fusions.name: Carcass Bloom
fusions.desc: Spores burst from your body, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Spore Spout
fusions.desc: Spouts a clot of spores that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Bone Garden
fusions.desc: Raises a mat of growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Rot Takes All
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance.
